hints.title: Operation Inversion
hints.text: After k operations, the target expression becomes num1 minus k times num2.

hints.title: Sum of Powers Representation
hints.text: The remaining difference must be expressible as the sum of exactly k powers of two.

hints.title: Bit Count Bounding
hints.text: Check if the set bit count of the difference is at most k while the value is at least k.

hints.title: Bit Count Search Code

complexity.notes: Testing values of k up to 60 runs in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice of power of two at each step fails due to non-local constraints.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inverts the algebra to express target as k powers of two and checks bit constraints.
